verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a no-code UI in which marketers build audiences once the schema is configured, and Customer Studio as the self-serve interface for building audiences on top of traits. The company's own comparison also describes a business-user UI for visual audience filtering. Missing for 10: any evidence of an estimated audience size or preview before activation, explicit documentation of behavioral/event conditions inside the visual builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Once the schema is configured, marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI.
Build audiences, explore segments, and activate data in minutes. The self-serve interface for marketers.
Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top.
a business-user UI for visual audience filtering
